before.meaningZh: （名詞）銀；銀幣；銀器；（形容詞）銀的；銀製的；銀色的
before.meaningEn: (n.) a valuable pale grey metal used for coins, jewelry and household articles; coins or tableware made of silver. (adj.) made of silver, or shiny pale grey in color.
before.usagePattern: a/the silver; silver of N; be silver
before.sourceNote: 高中英文參考詞彙表（111學年度起適用，大考中心）
before.usagePatternZh: 銀／銀器；某物的銀；是銀色的／銀製的

after.usagePattern: made of silver; silver coins; silver hair

patches.reason: Use concrete metal/coins/color constructions; a silver may separately mean a medal, so do not claim that count use never exists.
patches.retrieval: Actual direct dictionary definitions and complete current constructions read. Reviewer bilingual construction examples, not a quotation.
